document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The  North  Hanninah  runs  through  sheer  chasms  and 
uncrossable sloughs. Your party is forced inland several times, 
and  you  risk  losing  the  river.  On  the  second  evening,  your 
march stops at a well-drained knoll, where you pitch camp and 
take Bernard off to hunt.

While stalking a snowshoe hare under a mossy rock shelf, 
you hear a growl above and to your left. Foam oozing from its 
jaws, a wolverine leaps straight for your companion.

If any of your party require healing, you may restore 1 hit point each. 
Make a Firearms (Rifle/Shotgun) roll: if you hit, go to 88; if you 
miss, go to 94.
